text:
Acme Admin: Hey team — after our IdP change we can't open one of our projects in the console. Getting a 403: "You do not have permission to view this project" when clicking Projects -> Acme-Integrations. Was working yesterday.
Jordan S: Thanks for the report. Can you confirm if this user is logging in via SSO or a service account?
Acme Admin: SSO only. We've done a SCIM group rename (engineering -> eng-team) and rotated a few claims.
Priya N: Pinged the org owner to get screenshots. Did you see any errors on the client side or just the 403 page?
Acme Admin: Just the 403. Console shows project list but the specific project throws 403. Other projects fine.
Ethan R: Sounds like role/claim mapping issue. After SCIM rename, group->role mapping might not be mapping to project-level roles. Can you paste a JWT (redact tokens) or the ID token claims?
Acme Admin: Here's the minimal claims (redacted):
```
{"iss":"https://idp.example.com","sub":"user:123","email":"ops@acme.com","groups":["eng-team"],"roles":["project-admin"]}
```
But note our IdP changed the role claim name from `roles` to `x_roles` in the last deploy.
Kaitlyn M: Aha. If Redwood's SSO mapping expects `roles` but IdP now sends `x_roles` we won't pick up project-admin and the console will treat you as no-access -> 403. That fits the narrow-project-only symptom (other projects map via org-level role).
Jordan S: Can you check the org-level mapping in Admin -> Auth -> SCIM / SSO mapping? There was a recent change to allow custom claim names but it doesn't auto-migrate existing mappings.
Acme Admin: I can only see the 'Group claim' set to `groups`. Role claim field is blank on our end.
Priya N: Workaround: we can push a temporary role for the affected user via the admin API while you update mapping. If you can share a service token or let us run the resync, we can repro and patch.
Ethan R: Engineering ops — can you run a manual resync for org `org_741`? I'll paste the admin-command below.
audit-bot: Automated note: request logged to ticket #CS-4821 by Jordan S at 2024-06-04 15:12 UTC
Kaitlyn M: Command to trigger SCIM/resync (requires org-admin token):
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_741/sso/resync
Authorization: Bearer <ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "force": true,
  "reconcile_groups": true
}
```
Jordan S: If you can't run that, we can do a short-lived patch by attaching the `project-admin` role to your user id via our internal admin UI/API. That will restore access immediately while you update IdP claim mapping.
Acme Admin: We don't want to share tokens. Could you do the patch if we grant a one-time consent?
Priya N: Yep — security ok with a scoped, auditable change. I just need the exact external user id (sub) and the project id.
Acme Admin: sub=user:123, project=proj_998
Ethan R: I'll escalate to eng-platform to add `project-admin` to sub=user:123 on proj_998 and trigger a full resync. Also logging request for a small release note to add a warning when role claim name doesn't match.
Kaitlyn M: Assigning to eng-platform oncall @Ethan R — please confirm when done. Also capturing repro steps: 1) Rename SCIM group -> group name change 2) IdP changes role claim key 3) No mapping update in Redwood 4) User loses project-scoped role -> 403 5) Manual add-of-role or resync restores access.
Ethan R: Oncall here. Reproduced locally with a test org. Root cause: SSO mapping code did not fallback to custom claim `x_roles`. Quick fixes: (A) apply in-place mapping for org_741 to read `x_roles`, (B) run a background resync to apply new mappings to all members of eng-team. I'll run A+B now.
Jordan S: ETA? Customer is blocked from a production project.
Ethan R: Starting mapping patch now — will update in ~15 min. After patch I'll run:
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/internal/admin/projects/proj_998/members
Authorization: Bearer <ENG_OPS_TOKEN>
{
  "user_sub": "user:123",
  "role": "project-admin"
}
```
Kaitlyn M: Note for postmortem: capture which IdP change introduced `x_roles` and suggest a migration guide for customers. Also check our onboarding UI for explicit guidance to set 'role claim' name.
audit-bot: Action logged: eng-platform mapping patch started by Ethan R at 2024-06-04T15:23:12Z
Ethan R: Patch applied and resync kicked off. I can confirm via the resync job logs: "reconciled 42 members, 1 project role attached, 0 failures"
Jordan S: Can you confirm customer can access?
Acme Admin: I can now open proj_998. Access restored, thanks! 
Priya N: Great — leaving instructions for Acme to update IdP mapping to `roles` or to set the custom role claim in Redwood console. Also recommending a weekly SCIM audit for group/role drift.
Kaitlyn M: Closing as workaround applied; will follow up with a permanent UI/guardrail in a ticket. :white_check_mark:
